description: Octet / OneVision org-wide shared Renovate preset. Extend via: "extends": ["github>Onevision-io/renovate-config"]

packageRules.description: Never auto-open major bumps org-wide (open manually / review).

devDependencies: auto-merge on green (they don't ship to prod), but wait 3 days to match-or-exceed pnpm repos' own supply-chain cool-off (efone-crm renovate.json sets minimumReleaseAge: 2 days; aligned here to the org-wide top-level 3 days so pnpm's own gate never rejects what Renovate proposed). Council 2026-08-05 fast-merge softened for pnpm-safety 2026-09-08.

Cross-org private git deps (Octetsolutions/core_auth, core_voip, new_octet-version) are UNLOOKUPABLE by the hosted Renovate App: Renovate authenticates with the installation token of the repo it is renovating (Onevision-io / eFone), and that token cannot read another org's private repos -- the Octetsolutions installation (147134544, repository_selection=all) is irrelevant to it. Result was a permanent 'Failed to look up git-refs package ... no-result' WARN on every Dependency Dashboard + a failing renovate/artifacts check. These pins are bumped by hand (e.g. onevision-app-v2 #354), so disable the lookup rather than leave a red check. To RE-ENABLE: add a Mend Developer Portal org secret holding a token with repo-read on Octetsolutions, add a hostRules entry {matchHost: github.com, hostType: git-refs, token: ...}, then delete this rule. 2026-09-17.

Renovate-only consolidation (owner decision 2026-09-28): group ALL non-major updates into ONE PR per repo, automerge patch+minor on green CI (platformAutomerge respects required checks -- never bypasses branch protection). digest/lockFileMaintenance ride the same group+label but aren't forced to automerge if not already covered by patch/minor semantics.

Owner decision 2026-09-28: @v2 tag refs dropped, all Octet-Public/* reusable workflows/actions stay SHA-pinned; Renovate bumps the pin. pinDigests keeps the trailing '# vX.Y.Z' comment automatically. Folded into the same weekly 'all non-major dependencies' group/PR (superseding the prior immediate/any-time rule added 2026-09-25) so it rides the normal Monday cadence and required-checks automerge like everything else -- never bypasses branch protection.

hostRules.description: Auth for private @octetsolutions/* packages on GitHub Packages so Renovate can regenerate lockfiles. Token is a Mend Developer Portal secret named OCTETSOLUTIONS_NPM_TOKEN (org-scope). Migrated 2026-08-05 from embedded encrypted{} because Mend deprecated in-config encrypted secrets.
